Entries.summer_3: Ugh, it's so hot even my horns are sweating.$a
Entries.summer_4: Just doin' a little testing, don't mind me.
Entries.thurs: Summer is tourist season in Mako Point, I think I'll just hide out here for the season.$h
Entries.GreenRain: Is it weird I love this weather? Like,big mood. Everything's soaked and dramatic. My vibe exactly.
Entries.GreenRainFinished: Ugh, it cleared up? Boo. I was thriving in the mess.
Entries.MovieInvitation: Ooooh? You're asking *me* out? Cute. I'll go, but I get to pick the snacks.
Entries.RejectMovieTicket_AlreadyInvitedBySomeon: Awkward... someone already claimed my chaos for the day.
Entries.RejectMovieTicket_AlreadyWatchedThisWeek: I already did the movie thing. Two nights in a row might make me seem *too* cultured.
Entries.RejectMovieTicket_DontWantToSeeThatMovie: That movie? Meh. Looks like emotional beige. Pass.
Entries.RejectMovieTicket: Normally I'd be all over that, but tonight? Nah. Something's off in the air.
Entries.breakUp: ...Wow. You really wanna do this? Alright. But don't look surprised when I don't forget you.
Entries.dating_EdelweissSeung_memory_oneyear: One year ago? Oh yeah, the Seung thing. Feels like ten. I'm not haunted. Not really.
Entries.RejectBouquet_NotDatable: I'm flattered. But also very, very off-limits.
Entries.RejectBouquet_VeryLowHearts: ...That's cute, but we're not even *friends*. Maybe start there?
Entries.RejectBouquet_LowHearts: You're sweet, but we barely know each other. Let's not rush into wild declarations.
Entries.RejectBouquet: Romantic, but a little premature. Catch me again when we've caused a little more trouble together.
Entries.AcceptBouquet: You just handed me a heart on a stick. I'm in. Let's set something on fire. Figuratively. Mostly.
Entries.SpouseFarmhouseClutter: I may or may not have claimed every surface. Artistic chaos, babe. You'll live.
Entries.Spouse_MonstersInHouse: Okay, who let gremlins in? I thought *I* was the monster in this house.
Entries.SpouseStardrop: ...What the hell. I feel like I'm vibrating. Did you spike this with something weird and romantic?
Entries.RejectMermaidPendant_NeedHouseUpgrade: Love me in a shack, sure, but maybe wait 'til we've got plumbing.
Entries.RejectMermaidPendant_NotDatable: Flattered. But I'm not in the market for soul-binding right now.
Entries.RejectMermaidPendant_NpcWithSomeoneElse: Oh no no no. I'm someone else's problem now.
Entries.RejectMermaidPendant_PlayerWithSomeoneEl: Unless you're into dramatic three-way heartbreak, this won't work.
Entries.RejectMermaidPendant_Under8Hearts: You're jumping the gun. My heart doesn't even twitch for you yet.
Entries.RejectMermaidPendant_Under10Hearts: I *like* you, but marriage? That's, like, a blood pact.
Entries.RejectMermaidPendant_Under10Hearts_Asked: You keep asking like I'll change my mind. That's kinda hot. Still no.
Entries.RejectMermaidPendant: Commitment? With me? You must be more chaotic than I thought.
Entries.divorced: You let me go? Ballsy. Painful. Bold. Noted.
Entries.RejectGift_Divorced: You don't get to be sweet now. That ship exploded.
Entries.RejectMermaidPendant_Divorced: We already lit that bridge on fire. You wanna try again on the ashes?
Entries.RejectBouquet_Divorced: ...Seriously? We did this dance. I tripped. You ghosted. Let it rot.
Entries.WipedMemory: You wiped me? Damn. I must've hurt you good.
Entries.Resort: Sun, sand, and zero responsibilities. I could get *used* to this.
Entries.Resort_Bar: Pineapple in a cup. Dangerously perfect.
Entries.Resort_Chair: Finally. A throne worthy of my nonsense.
Entries.Resort_Dance: You *have* to dance with me. No one else is bringing this level of chaos.
Entries.Resort_Entering: This place smells like sunscreen and questionable choices.
Entries.Resort_Leaving: That was fun. Let's do it again. Or never speak of it. Dealer's choice.
Entries.Resort_Shore: I might just live here now. Tell the sea she has a new roommate.
Entries.Resort_Towel: Claimed this spot like a seagull with a vendetta.
Entries.Resort_Umbrella: Me? Hiding from the sun? Never. Okay, maybe a little.
Entries.Resort_Wander: Letting the wind decide where I go. Very zen, very unhinged.
Entries.AcceptBirthdayGift_Negative: ...Oof. Were you trying to make a statement?
Entries.AcceptBirthdayGift_Positive: This? For *me*? Okay, I might cry. Or laugh. Or scream. Good gift.
Entries.AcceptBirthdayGift: I didn't think you'd remember. Points for surprise sentimentality.
Entries.DumpsterDiveComment: Find anything cursed? If you do, dibs.
Entries.HitBySlingshot: Ow! Was that an *accident* or foreplay?
Entries.FlowerDance_Accept: You just made this whole boring thing worth it.
Entries.FlowerDance_Decline: Aw, I'd rather be spinning with storm clouds. Maybe next time.
Entries.Fair_Judging: Judgment day. Let's see what chaos you've summoned.
Entries.Fair_Judged_PlayerLost_Skipped: Hah. You skipped the show and still lost? Iconic.
Entries.Fair_Judged_PlayerLost: Womp womp. I'd lie and say you did great, but...no.
Entries.Fair_Judged_PlayerWon: You *won*?! Guess I better raise my standards.
Entries.Fair_Judged: So that's how the town gets its kicks. Strange little place.
Entries.WinterStar_GiveGift_Before_Spouse: Whatever it is, I'll love it. Or pretend really well.
Entries.WinterStar_GiveGift_Before: For *me*? You're either brave or into disappointment.
Entries.WinterStar_GiveGift_After_Spouse: You spoil me. I'm not mad about it.
Entries.WinterStar_GiveGift_After: This is...actually sweet. Who are you and what've you done with the farmer?
Entries.WinterStar_ReceiveGift: A gift? You sure you don't have the wrong chaotic nightmare?
Entries.AcceptGift_(O)96: Oooh, tropical! I'll accept this offering, but you owe me a pina colada.
Entries.SummitEvent_Dialogue3_CacklingCaracal_Ig: Look at that. Everything's *tiny* from up here. Makes me feel huge and small at the same time. Kinda like... loving you.

Entries.IggyNova: Man... When it rains it really pours here, huh?
